## Checklist

- [ ] One task, atomic commits, Conventional Commits
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] A changeset is included if published behavior under `src/` changed
- [ ] Indicator writes covered for completion, error and early unsubscription
- [ ] No runtime dependency and no UI framework import added under `src/`
- [ ] README updated when the public API changed
